1.

Through storm and cloud God shows our way. He has His time, and the night’s strife Soon turns to day.

2.

He governs all in grace, All serves but His might. Whatever He does, to us brings grace, His path is light and power.

3.

When He has stretched out His arm, Who can withstand His work? When it is He who pleads for us, Who can go against Him?

4.

To Him we leave To choose for us here. Admiring, we soon shall see How wise, how strong He is.

5.

We cannot grasp Him. His earth, His heaven’s veil, Yet show God in sovereign robe Rules all and makes all well.
